note_en: 成 after a verb marks what something turns into: 他把刨冰摊发展成了…小店 "he turned the shaved-ice stand into a little shop." English uses "into," but Chinese attaches 成 directly to the verb (发展成 "develop into," 翻译成 "translate into," 变成 "become"), often with 把 bringing the object before the verb.
